title: $JOINER
description: References a field from the Joiner record associated with the current source record. $JOINER is available after a Joiner formula, such as JOIN_OBJECT_SOURCE, JOIN_OBJECT_TARGET, JOIN_OBJECT_CONNECTION, or JOIN_JSON, has been applied.

descriptionCallouts.content: New to Joiner? See What is a Joiner? for details.

examples:
$JOINER.Name
-- Accesses the "Name" field from the joined record.
